title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.09.3
notes:
- Drag multiple audio clips and patterns from the Playlist Clip Picker onto a track. Reorder sources inside the picker and save their order with the project.
- Use All, Used and Unused filters for the current arrangement. Picker color strips follow Playlist clip colors.
- Play or stop up to eight audio clip and supported pattern previews independently. Fixed silent previews for clips and notes on later rack channels. Patterns that use hosted third-party instruments can be rendered to audio for preview.
- Improved the Playlist overview scrollbar. Its handle stays proportional as the arrangement grows and keeps a usable minimum width in both scrollbar styles.
- Added basic interface translations for French, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian. Choose a language in Settings > General > Language. English is the fallback for text outside the initial translation coverage.
- Added a searchable offline User Guide under Help. Show me where highlights relevant controls in supported articles, and Back to guide returns to the article.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
